app_type: Enterprise SaaS / CFO Financial Dashboard & Recovery Command Center
design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast Tactical Precision for Finance (Institutional Navy & Obsidian Slate)

theme_strategy.description: Ultra-crisp dark theme with charcoal-obsidian cards for dense financial monitoring, with warm slate light mode option. State-only visual signals (Emerald for recovered/approved, Crimson/Amber for leakage/at risk, Violet/Cyan for AI & rules).

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk / Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans
font_rules: DO NOT use Inter for main headings; use Cabinet Grotesk or Outfit with tight tracking (tracking-tight) for authority.
Use JetBrains Mono / tabular numbers (font-mono tnum) for all financial dollar amounts ($124,500.00), confidence percentages (98.4%), and clause numbers to ensure vertical visual alignment.
H1 Maximum Size: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl. Subtitles must be text-lg to text-xl.
Overlines / Eyebrows: uppercase, text-xs, font-mono, tracking-[0.2em], text-emerald-400 or text-slate-400.

colors.palette_name: Tactical Financial Recovery (Obsidian, Signal Emerald, Risk Crimson, AI Violet)

leakage_danger.usage: High severity leakage detected, unrecovered financial loss, contract violations

recovered_success.usage: Recovered funds, approved claims, verified OTIF/fee calculations

in_dispute_warning.usage: Claim submitted to Amazon/retailer, pending vendor response, expiring dispute window

ai_copilot_accent.usage: AI contract term extraction, automated recovery email generation, streaming draft

contrast_rules: Never use pure black #000000; use #0b0f19 or #0f172a with subtle slate blue undertones.
Green and Red are strictly state-only for monetary gain vs loss. Buttons must use primary slate/emerald branding, not plain red/green unless explicitly committing/approving actions.
Hover states must explicitly declare text color: hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white.

layout_and_grids.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Command Center (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 lg:gap-6). Direct grid children with h-full cards.
layout_and_grids.kpi_banner_ratio: 5 key metric cards spanning grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4
layout_and_grids.case_detail_layout: Asymmetric 3-column split (Col-1: Summary & Calc Breakdown - 5 cols; Col-2: Contract Clause & AI Email Streamer - 4 cols; Col-3: Escalation Workflow & Audit History - 3 cols)
layout_and_grids.bento_features_landing: Tetris grid on marketing view (Hero banner 8 cols, live recovery counter 4 cols, domain cards 4 cols each)
layout_and_grids.padding_standard: p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 for containers. Internal card padding minimum p-5 to prevent text collision with borders.

public_landing_page.components: Header with live ticker ribbon + Auth sign-in trigger, Hero split (Left: bold value proposition 'Stop Profit Leakage in Amazon & Retail Contracts', Right: Interactive Leakage Simulator), Domain Grid (Amazon Vendor Fee Overcharge, OTIF Fines, Price Variance, Rebates, Freight), ROI Calculator Widget, Security & Audit Compliance Badges, Clerk Auth Modal integration.

control_tower_dashboard.components: Top KPI strip (Leakage Identified, Recoverable Amount, In-Claim Dispute, Recovered YTD, Recovery Rate %), Monthly Trend Chart & Leakage by Domain (Recharts), Expiring Dispute Windows Alert Bar, Counterparty Leakage Heatmap (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Wayfair), My Action Queue table with 1-click Escalation.

leakages_table_view.components: Multi-filter bar (Domain, Counterparty, Status, Severity, Assigned Role), Search by Order/ASIN/Invoice #, Sortable Table with risk score badge, Quick Action Drawer preview, Bulk dispute export & Batch Assign button.

case_detail_view.components: Expected vs Charged calculation math widget with side-by-side delta, Contract Clause citation block with confidence rating (e.g. 98.2% AI Match to Section 4.2 Fee Schedule), Role-based Action Bar (Assign/Escalate to Senior CFO, Approve Claim, Reject, Send Recovery Email, Record Recovery), Streaming AI Email Draft Editor (Claude powered), Audit History Timeline & Team Comments.

recovery_kanban_pipeline.components: Drag-and-Drop / Categorized Kanban columns: Identified -> Under Review -> Escalated to Senior -> Claim Drafted -> Submitted to Vendor -> Recovered / Settled -> Written Off. Card displays amount, deadline tag, assignee avatar, counterparty logo.

data_ingestion_portal.components: Domain selector (Marketplace Fees, OTIF, Freight, Price Variance, Rebates), Drag-and-drop CSV/Excel dropzone with sample template download link, Parsing progress indicator, Ingested Batches log, Instant Detection Trigger button.

truth_layer_contracts.components: Counterparty rule cards (e.g., Amazon Vendor Agreement 2026 - Fee cap 12.5%), Rule Versioning control, AI Contract Reader dropzone ('Paste contract text or PDF to auto-generate rule cards'), Active rule toggle switches.

assurance_and_audit.components: Assurance queue for high-value claims requiring dual-signature approval, Immutable Audit Log table tracking every user action, status change, and email dispatch with timestamp, user role, and IP.

copilot_chat.components: AI Assistant drawer 'Ask about financial leakages', suggested prompts ('What is our biggest Amazon fee overcharge this month?', 'Draft an OTIF dispute for Walmart invoice #9921').

role_based_controls.behavior: Render explicit role badge in top navbar. Disable restricted action buttons (e.g. Analyst sees 'Escalate to Senior Approver', Approver sees 'Approve & Dispatch Claim Email', Admin sees 'Manage Team Roles').

rules: No universal transition: all. Use explicit transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
Hover effects on table rows: subtle glow border-l-2 border-emerald-500 bg-slate-800/40.
AI Streaming text effect for email draft generation (simulated or real SSE indicator).
KPI counter entry animation and progress bar fill on load.

testing_attributes_convention.rule: Every interactive element (buttons, filters, inputs, tabs, table cells, modal triggers) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use clear Shadcn UI patterns with custom Tailwind styling.
Include pre-populated sample mock data for Amazon vendor fees, OTIF claims, freight overcharges, and price variances so the user can immediately test all recovery flows without manual CSV uploads.
Make sure the escalation workflow lets a junior Analyst assign a leakage issue to a Senior Approver/CFO with automated notification toast.
Implement streaming AI draft generation for recovery emails with editable subject line, recipient field, and send trigger.
Always set explicit text color on hover states.
